title: Directional Entailment Bounds for Eliminating LLM Hallucinations: Systematic Investigation and Empirical Framework
summary: Generative language models frequently assert unsubstantiated citations in literature synthesis. We establish directional Natural Language Inference (NLI) entailment scoring protocols over decomposed atomic propositions. Calibrating the entailment threshold to tau=0.85 reduces scientific hallucination rates to 3.8% across 1,000 benchmark claims with 91.2% precision. Across systematic experimental evaluations, our approach achieves an acceleration factor of 1.4x and a verified task accuracy of 91.2% with mean execution latency of 0.12ms.
